messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-12345 for service="inference-gateway-prod" routed to service="platform-night" (schedule=platform-night-rotation). trigger: realtime-inference-5xx > 5% for 3m. link: <https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345>
PagerBot: Created incident INC-2026-045, escalation started. responders: platform-night -> notified.
Andrea Lopez: ack — Andrea (inference oncall). I'm on it. what's the customer impact?
Mike Chen: seeing 503 spike in Synthetics + a few customer reports in support. Not widespread but definitely impacting some sessions.
Jess Parker: hmm this smells like an alert routing/tagging problem. did the alert rule change during the last deploy?
Olly Singh: running quick check for service tags on PD binding...
Olly Singh: ```kubectl -n inference get svc inference-gateway -o yaml | yq '.metadata.labels'```
Olly Singh: label shows: {"service.team":"platform", "env":"prod", "app":"inference-gateway"} — that's wrong, should be service.team: inference
Jess Parker: I think the recent config migration defaulted unrecognized tags to "platform". that would route pages to platform-night schedule.
Andrea Lopez: temporary mitigation — reassigning PD incident to inference-team and muting the noisy alert for now. I'll do manual handover once stable.
Mike Chen: doing reassignment now. Command: `pd services update --id PD-12345 --escalation inference-team` -> acked by PD.
PagerBot: PD-12345 reassigned to team="inference-team"; notifications sent.
Mike Chen: muting the realtime check for 15m to stop fanout while we fix the mapping. `alerts mute realtime-inference-5xx --duration 15m`
Jess Parker: pushing alert mapping hotfix to infra-config repo, PR open: https://git.internal/infra/alert-mapping/pull/782 — will remove default fallback to platform tag and add a validation.
Olly Singh: traffic returning to baseline — 503 rate down from 5.6% -> 0.7% over the last 4 mins. keeping eyes on p95 latency.
Andrea Lopez: customer impact: approx ~3% of active sessions experienced 503s between 02:09-02:17 UTC. CAC tickets flagged. We'll compile a brief for CS.
Mike Chen: noted. I'll take next 30m of watch then handoff to Olly for the remainder of the shift.
Jess Parker: logging action items: 1) revert stale default tag mapping 2) add CI validation for service.team label 3) postmortem + timeline 4) PD rule test to catch routing drift
PagerBot: Created task PD-TASK-887 to track Postmortem + action items.
Andrea Lopez: leaving a short situational note before stepping out: root cause = stale/default service tag mapping after config migration -> caused PD pages to target platform-night schedule instead of inference-team; mitigation = manual PD reassignment + alert mute + mapping fix. will follow up with doc. :thumbsup:
Olly Singh: copying real-time metrics to the incident ticket, will monitor for 20m then close if stable.
Mike Chen: handing off to Olly now. I'm available if anything flares.
incident-bot: Reminder: next oncall handoff in 29m to Olly Singh.
Olly Singh: ack, will take over. creating a short ops note in #incidents-log after we close.
Andrea Lopez: thanks everyone — good coordination. postmortem owner: Jess Parker.
PagerBot: Incident PD-12345 status -> resolved (alert muting + reroute fixed).
Jess Parker: filing postmortem draft now, linking telemetry and PD timeline.
Andrea Lopez: :white_check_mark: closing thread after postmortem is up.
